data.name: Manickam
data.gender_notes: Manickam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manickam is a Tamil name derived from the Tamil word 'mani' meaning gem and 'kamam' meaning desire or wealth. It is believed to be the name of the god of wealth, Kubera. This name is a symbol of abundance, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Manickam carries the meaning “God of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manickam usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that brings wealth and prosperity, both material and spiritual.
data.etymology: Manickam belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manickam total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Manickam is a Tamil name that resonates deeply within the South Indian culture. It is a coveted name, bestowed upon children in hopes of receiving blessings of abundance, prosperity, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Manickam is the name of the lord of wealth, Kubera, who is regarded as the giver of all material possessions. This name is a reminder of the traditional belief in the accumulation of wealth, which is seen as a sign of success in society.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Manickam holds great significance in Hindu beliefs. It is believed that the name is ethereally linked to the god of wealth, Kubera, symbolizing prosperity, contentment, and spiritual growth. The nameManickam is a reminder that wealth is not just physical possessions but also the inner peace and happiness that comes with material abundance. The name is a constant reminder to focus on the spiritual aspects of life and to use material wealth for the betterment of oneself and others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Manickam: One who holds the divine consciousness in heart. A beacon of light, illuminating the path towards self-realization.
